provenance.derivation: Paths independently derived from the geographic inventory and intersected with pre-consolidation page dates. Content IDs read from the old immutable contract; destinations derived from area identity. Current redirect maps and fixtures were compared only after expectations were built.

variantDefinitions.head: HEAD the exact from path
variantDefinitions.no-slash: GET from without the final slash
variantDefinitions.html: GET from without the final slash, then append .html
variantDefinitions.double-slash: GET from replacing /areas/ with /areas// (unchanged for the legacy /work/ alias)
variantDefinitions.unreserved-escape: GET from replacing its first ASCII letter with a percent-encoded byte

expectations.finalCanonical: origin plus destination path for HTML pages/documents
expectations.query: Preserve the exact query bytes before any destination fragment.
expectations.fragment: When no explicit fragment is supplied by Location, the browser retains the input fragment.
expectations.liveHttpEdge: Live HTTP may first 301 to the same HTTPS path and query before the Worker 308.
expectations.indexing: Service and hub pages must be indexable; downloads intentionally retain noindex.
expectations.unknownPaths: Return actual 404 with noindex; never funnel unknown counties to a hub.
